give desktop an option to have the prior hud without all this useless garbage on it and please give the option for the user to disable all these new keybinds you've been adding under the f1-f8 keys or even better let use modify our keybinds ourselves

a continuation of my last post you guys still have yet to make it so peopple can turn off those stupid profile/nameplate animations that obscure the names as if you guys are gonna rip off discord at least do it properly as last i checked at least discord lets you disable that stuff, my vison is only getting worse by the day and i cant even read peoples profiles correctly anymore if they have the decorations turned on

and a bit of a rant if i wanted to sit here and constantly see the awful type of hud on roblox id go play roblox instead of whatever this game is turning into these last two updates have be straight slop for desktop users with no options to adjust or make the things added bearable for users that dont want to see this shoved in their face

out of the last ten years of updates this year's has been hands down the worse of them
